## Description

An orange amoeba (carotenoids) of 30–50 µm with thin filopodia, specialised on zygnematalean algae. It
attaches to a cell of *Spirogyra* or *Mougeotia*, dissolves a round hole in its wall and sucks out the
protoplast; then it forms a digestive cyst and divides inside into 2–4.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

[Wall perforation](../../mechanics/feeding-and-phagocytosis.md) (`feeding = "perforation"`, `perforation_hours`):
it leaves the empty wall. It divides inside a cyst (`divides_in_cyst`). Perforation time estimated; no
published µmax.
